purpose: three legendary Erin card frame concepts

variants.name: 황금 문장
variants.direction: DESIGN A — FORGED GOLD HERALDIC FRAME. Strong, solid premium collectible presence. Wrap the EXISTING flowing black character-frame contours with substantial warm antique GOLD metal edging, broad sculpted bevels and decisive sunlit highlights. Deep royal-purple enamel visible behind gold; keep enough black ink to belong to the established family. Restrained symmetrical gold corner clasps, confident shapes and one small faceted amber gemstone worked into the top rim, outside title text. The wooden tankard badge becomes a small crowned tankard medallion with a thick gold rim. Use simple laurel-like heraldic relief only near the badge, with no new text. Make this the most restrained and readable of the three concepts: expensive medieval gold forging, saturated amber and purple, no magic smoke, no floating effects. Exact same main illustration and panel geometry.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ONE legendary-rarity Korean medieval fantasy character card concept, complete upright 1024x1536, exact 2:3 rectangular silhouette. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the user-approved illustration/text/layout. Image 2 is the approved character-card format, supporting structure and Korean lettering reference. Upgrade the FRAME of image 1 to clearly read as a rare, special LEGENDARY card. Preserve the recognisable family: purple stock, bold tapered black ink waves, wide cream title and rules panels, large curved character illustration window and a small tankard badge at artwork bottom.
LOCK THE ILLUSTRATION: same beautiful adult Erin, same face/green eyes/blonde wavy hair/braid, pose with cheek resting in hand and raised foaming wooden tankard, cream blouse and brown corset, large patterned brown-and-cream skirt across the lap and lower half, hip bottle, warm tavern fireplace and snowy window. Do not crop or zoom her, do not substitute a bust portrait; preserve all visible skirt area. Do not alter her identity, expression, pose, outfit, background composition or art-window dimensions. Main painting remains essentially unchanged. Only frame material, border ornament, badge treatment and restrained outer-edge light may change.

Bottom THREE lines: "술병 네 가지 가운데" / "세 병을 아무렇게나 꺼냅니다." / "[가끔 술주정을 부립니다]". Preserve literal square brackets on last line. No extra rarity labels, lore, mechanics, numbers, text or watermark. Cream panel interiors must remain clean and continuous; no ornaments behind letters, no narrower rules panel. Artwork/badge must not invade text. Keep one complete card edge-to-edge, no external scenery, margins, cast shadows, stands or extra cards. Final interior opaque, rounded corners allowed, exterior alpha only. variants.name: 호박빛 스테인드글라스
variants.direction: DESIGN B — AMBER STAINED-GLASS LEGENDARY FRAME. A distinctly different material and construction from an ordinary gold outline. Keep the existing character-frame silhouette and black curves, but build narrow outer BORDER bands of large faceted amber/honey stained-glass mosaic pieces held in dark bronze leading. Upper rim has a shallow fan-shaped glass crest; side bands follow the same flowing curved frame, not straight pillars. Alternate a FEW broad honey-gold, dark violet and warm cream glass segments, with a gentle translucent inner glow and broad reflected highlights. Keep original wide cream text fields. The wooden tankard badge sits inside a round amber-glass and bronze sunburst medallion, modest size and above rules. Tavern warmth and rich amber glass make this feel like a unique medieval treasured card. No new illustrated objects or characters. No gold laurel crown, no star particles: this concept is defined by geometric glass inlay and warm luminous material. Same painting and skirt composition.

variants.name: 보랏빛 마법 금박
variants.direction: DESIGN C — ARCANE NIGHT-PLUM GOLD-FOIL FRAME. A magical legendary collectible treatment, distinctly different from heavy forged metal and geometric stained glass. Deep midnight-purple/luminous plum border, preserve the flowing black ink silhouette. Slim bright gold-leaf inlays sweep in elegant S-curves along the existing OUTER FRAME. Restrained constellation-like small stars and a few broad gold orbital arcs are EMBOSSED only into the border, suggesting animated legendary foil without covering the picture. A delicate violet-to-gold iridescent sheen follows the edges, with a soft halo kept INSIDE the rectangular silhouette. The tankard badge has a dark plum enamel surround, gold rim and one tiny star glint. No chunky corner armor or stained-glass tiles. Keep gold leaf motifs sparse and readable. All effects confined to the border, no particles crossing face, clothing or words; exact same warm tavern portrait and ample visible skirt. Wide cream panels stay fully opaque and uncluttered.
